coordinateConvention: Map source coordinates stay unchanged in ClassicMapObject.Value/Key. Runtime translation is SourceOrigin only. Structure drawing anchor is foundation center; terrain/unit/smudge drawing anchor is source first-cell center. Native smudge canvas already contains its full Width/Height footprint; do not tile or scale it.
passabilityConvention: Explicit original IsPassable/Buildable overrides preserved; static defaults: smudge passable/buildable, other occupied scenery blocks. Occupation masks and all original flags retained, not guessed into extra occupied cells.
